final_message:
Partial refunds are fixed. `npm test` now passes all 20 tests, including both cases in `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`.

The cause was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`. The file documents `percent` as 0–100, but the code multiplied the amount by it directly, so a 50% refund of 1250 came out as 62500 (100x too large). The fix divides by 100:

```js
exports.partialRefund = (payment, percent) => ({ currency: payment.currency, amount: Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100) });
```

Nothing else in `src`, `test`, `scripts` or `docs` calls `partialRefund`, so the change has no other callers to update. I didn't commit anything.
